Blockchain technology works like a shared digital record book that is not controlled by any single person or company. Instead, it is maintained by a network of computers, which makes the system secure and transparent. In this system, information is grouped into "blocks." Once a block is verified and added to the chain, the information inside it cannot be changed or deleted. This is because each block is cryptographically linked to the one before it, creating a strong chain that is very difficult to tamper with or fraudulently alter.
